entities.summary: Anna Maria Adorni Botti, born Anna Maria Adorni, was an Italian religious sister of the Handmaids of the Immaculata, a congregation she established in 1857. Botti's vocation was to the religious life, and as a child believed she was destined for the missions and later as a Franciscan religious sister. After being widowed, she did pastoral work in Parma, where she established and ran the congregation of the Handmaids of the Immaculata until her death.
